text:
and suddenly life

in my poor man's plate

a lean piece of heavenly pig

here on my plate

watching me

watching you

or killing a fly without malice

annihilating the light

or making it

making it

like someone who opens his eyes and chooses

a sky overflowing

in the empty plate

Rubens plus onions

plus tears

so many stories

black indigestible miracles

and the star of the East

sandwiched in

and the bones of love

so gnawed and so hard

shining on another plate

this hunger of my own

exists

it is the soul's desire

which is the body

it is the rose of fat

that grows old

in its fleshly heaven

mea culpa, clouded eye

mea culpa, black morsel

mea culpa, divine nausea

there is no one else here

in this empty plate

but me

devouring my eyes

and yours

translation.title: Villainous Song
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the stored Spanish original. The fractured lineation, sacramental language, grotesque food imagery, and self-consuming close are preserved; the source typo ‘el huesos’ is regularized as ‘the bones.’
